calendar.event.get.desc: Returns events on the specified calendar.
calendar.event.get.summary: Returns events on the specified calendar.

calendar.event.get.1.desc: Returns an event based on its Google Calendar ID. To retrieve an event using its iCalendar ID, call the events.list method using the iCalUID parameter.
calendar.event.get.1.summary: Returns an event based on its Google Calendar ID

gmail.user.messages.get.desc: Lists the messages in the user's mailbox. For more information, see [List Gmail messages](https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/list-messages).
gmail.user.messages.get.summary: Lists the messages in the user's mailbox

gmail.user.send.create.desc: Sends the specified, existing draft to the recipients in the `To`, `Cc`, and `Bcc` headers. For more information, see [Create and send draft emails](https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/drafts).
gmail.user.send.create.summary: Sends the specified, existing draft to the recipients in the `To`, `Cc`, and `Bcc` headers

gmail.user.send.create1.desc: Sends the specified message to the recipients in the `To`, `Cc`, and `Bcc` headers. For more information, see [Create and send email messages](https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides/sending).
gmail.user.send.create1.summary: Sends the specified message to the recipients in the `To`, `Cc`, and `Bcc` headers

notion.comment.create.desc: Creates a comment in a page or existing discussion thread.

notion.comment.list.desc: Retrieves a list of un-resolved [Comment objects](ref:comment-object) from a page or block.

notion.data_source.get.desc: Retrieve metadata and schema for a data source

notion.data_source.update.desc: Update properties of a data source

notion.databas.get.desc: Retrieves a database object using the ID specified. Returns database metadata including the list of data source IDs contained in the database.

notion.markdown.get.desc: Retrieve the full content of a Notion page rendered as enhanced Markdown. Designed for agentic and developer tools that work natively with Markdown instead of the block JSON returned by Retrieve block children.

notion.markdown.update.desc: Update the content of a Notion page using enhanced Markdown. Prefer `replace_content` to overwrite the whole page or `update_content` for targeted find-and-replace edits.
notion.markdown.update.summary: Update a page's content as Markdown

notion.move.create.desc: Move a page to a different parent location

notion.query.create.desc: Query a data source (database) using filters and sorts

notion.template.get.desc: List available templates for a data source
notion.template.get.summary: List templates in a data source
